name: DJ Fuzz Ball
summary:
DJ Fuzz Ball is a fast-paced momentum-based 3D Platformer where rhythm and momentum come together to bring a different kind of expression in platforming.

Take control of DJ Fuzz, an orange ball guy who wears a large pair of blue headphones, as you run, roll, jump, do tricks, grind and bounce in style through exciting worlds as you help him to take back his world from The Corruption.
